# Ordinary near-Grunbaum caps and centered chords do not balance section weights

This is an exact counterexample to an auxiliary ordinary-body inference,
not to OC or to the actual mixed-fiber contraction certificate. In
particular, no compatible A,B fibers or criticality certificate are
claimed for the body below.

Let

    K=conv{(-15,-22),(16,-4),(-2,25)},
    v_1=(1,0), v_2=(0,1), v_3=(-1,-1).

The source0 lies in int K and |K|=1223/2. The three normals sum to0.
For q_i=|K intersect {v_i.x>=0}| and
sigma_i=H_1(K intersect {v_i.x=0})/||v_i||, exact edge intersections give

| i | q_i/|K| | sigma_i | smaller/larger source-to-endpoint distance |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 128/279 | 9784/279 | 927/1519 |
| 2 | 625/1363 | 30575/1363 | 12151/18424 |
| 3 | 1369/2940 | 45251/2940 | 20531/24720 |

All three cap fractions are less than47/100<1/2. All three chord
endpoint-distance ratios are greater than1/sqrt(3). These strict
claims follow respectively by multiplication of positive integer
denominators and by the exact positive values

    3(927/1519)^2-1=270626/2307361,
    3(12151/18424)^2-1=103496627/339443776,
    3(20531/24720)^2-1=217829161/203692800.

Nevertheless sigma_1>2 sigma_3, and if lambda_i=1/sigma_i,

    lambda_1/(lambda_1+lambda_2+lambda_3)<2/9.

Thus even these relatively small ordinary cap fractions, together
with the universal chord-center ratio supplied by critical mixed
geometry, do not by themselves imply the sufficient balanced-weight
condition for endpoint contraction. The ACTUAL A section densities,
the common supporting body B, volume compatibility and the missing-
corner incidence must remain in an attempted proof.

For a direct check of the table, the coordinate endpoints of the
three sections are respectively

    x=0: y in [-412/31,196/9],
    y=0: x in [-419/47,392/29],
    x+y=0: x in [-419/60,412/49].

In the third case division by ||v_3||=sqrt(2) exactly cancels the
Euclidean length factor sqrt(2). Each displayed cap isolates one
triangle vertex; the triangle area formula gives its stated fraction.
The first section density is the largest and the third the smallest.
Every assertion is independently checked over rational arithmetic
by `../assets/pk-nov6/computations/verify_ordinary_three_cap_section_balance_root.py`.

The discovery script `../assets/pk-nov6/computations/search_three_cap_section_balance_root.py` is
only a falsification search. The displayed rational certificate is
the evidence for this auxiliary obstruction. It does not demonstrate
a failure under the stronger actual critical-circuit hypotheses.
